item.title: Verbose beta 283
item.description:
Titles that stay put

Mac

  • A page's count sits on the line above its title, like the date on Home. Matches Verbose Tasks. On the Mac, that line is in small capitals.
  • More › Transcribe again listens to a recording again with your current settings. The words it replaces stay. Choose Switch to the other words in More to go back. Your edits stay with the words you made them on.

Also on iPhone

  • Home, Library, Thoughts, and other tabs keep their title at the top as you scroll.
  • Find a dictation sits on the page, under the title.
